Done. Muse now runs a local tool loop: replies ending in a ```` ```muse-tool ```` block are parsed (last block wins), executed against a registry (`read_file`, `write_file`, `edit_file`, `list_dir`, `grep`, `bash`), and reported back to Muse as `TOOL RESULT <name> (ok|error)`. Text before a block streams as `agent_thought_chunk`; tool runs emit `tool_call`/`tool_call_update`; block-free replies stream as `agent_message_chunk` with `end_turn`. Paths are confined to the session cwd, file ops go through `fs/read_text_file`/`fs/write_text_file` when the client announced those capabilities (the agent now keeps `clientCapabilities`, session `cwd`, and answers its own outbound requests), the loop is capped at `MUSE_MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS`, and fake mode supports `MUSE_BRIDGE_FAKE_SCRIPT`/`MUSE_BRIDGE_FAKE_SENT`. One decision the contract didn't spell out: fake mode with no accounts.json now falls back to a `fake` account id instead of erroring, since the PM check seeds no accounts.

Changed paths:
- `bridge/acp-tools.mjs` (new: block parser, tool registry, path guard, intro builder)
- `bin/muse-acp.mjs` (tool loop, capabilities/cwd storage, client-request map, fake script)
- `tests/acp-tools.test.mjs` (new)

Verification: `node /tmp/muse-acp-tools/check.mjs "$PWD"` → OK; `node --test tests/acp.test.mjs tests/acp-cancel.test.mjs tests/acp-pending.test.mjs tests/acp-tools.test.mjs` → 15/15 pass (full suite 84/84).

```plan-fact
[
  {"item":1,"status":"done","evidence":["bin/muse-acp.mjs","bridge/acp-tools.mjs","cmd:node /tmp/muse-acp-tools/check.mjs \"$PWD\""]},
  {"item":2,"status":"done","evidence":["tests/acp-tools.test.mjs","bridge/acp-tools.mjs","cmd:node --test tests/acp.test.mjs tests/acp-cancel.test.mjs tests/acp-pending.test.mjs tests/acp-tools.test.mjs"]},
  {"item":3,"status":"done","evidence":["cmd:node --test tests/acp.test.mjs tests/acp-cancel.test.mjs tests/acp-pending.test.mjs tests/acp-tools.test.mjs"]}
]
```

APPROACH: replies are buffered through `driver.send` and classified after completion — a reply either becomes thought + tool calls or the final message; this is the only way to keep raw muse-tool blocks out of `agent_message_chunk` while routing pre-block text to `agent_thought_chunk`. Outgoing client fs requests use string ids (`muse-acp-N`) resolved via a pending map in the stdin loop, so they can never collide with inbound request ids.

LESSON: the PM's check.mjs is an authoritative interface spec — it seeded no `accounts.json`, which surfaced that fake mode required a registered account; reading the check before coding would have caught that on the first pass.

dispatchContext.rulesText:
- In verification scripts and tests that create temp dirs, use /tmp explicitly (mktemp -d /tmp/x.XXXXXX, or TMPDIR=/tmp): the writer sandbox denies mkdtemp in the system TMPDIR under /var/folders. Keep PM-written check scripts in /tmp/<name>/ (the guard blocks .mjs under .agents/).
- In a folder without git (live-folder mode), never put a task's expected_outputs or owns_paths under .bb/ (chat folders): the live snapshot skips .bb, so a file written there is never counted as produced and the task blocks as missing expected_outputs. Put task deliverables in a project folder such as docs/ or reports/.
